'''Fortress Auchindoun''' was a [[fortress]] of the [[Bleeding Hollow clan]] during the [[Invasion of Draenor]].

==Invasion of Draenor==
[[Kurdran Wildhammer]] had located the fortress which served as a stronghold to the [[Bleeding Hollow clan]]. [[Alleria Windrunner]]'s rangers had reported that they had seen a massive force moving towards the north and suspected that those troops were staging for another attack upon [[Azeroth]]. The [[Alliance Expedition|Alliance]] forces launched a raid against Auchindoun and razed the fortress to force the [[Horde of Draenor|Horde]] army to retreat or to be cut off and destroyed.<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Fall_of_Auchindoun_(WC2_Human) The Fall of Auchindoun (WC2 Human)]</ref>

In the aftermath, the blazing ruins of Auchindoun were surrounded by arcane powers. [[Khadgar]] examined the remains of the great fortress and learned from it the location of the [[Book of Medivh]] and the [[Skull of Gul'dan]].<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Deathwing_(WC2_Human) Deathwing (WC2 Human)]</ref>
